create_Metric_instance: create a Metric instance with metric names and optional log json path for tracking training stats
update_Metric_values: update a Metric instance with new values to track running average, EMA, and latest stats
get_stat_string_Metric: get a formatted stat string from a Metric instance showing iteration count and metric values
dump_log_Metric: dump the Metric stats and metric names to a JSON file for persistent logging
compute_ranks_VqaMetric: compute accuracy and ranks from scores and labels using the VqaMetric compute_ranks method
